svg.aria-label: The support of the square T in the direction u(z) as z runs once round: the largest of four sinusoids, one for each vertex, with corners at the multiples of pi/2. Its only smooth minimum is the trough of the sinusoid of the nearest vertex, at z = pi + beta, of depth minus delta
